findings.title: Pod is bound to a node that does not exist
findings.cause: the pod sets spec.nodeName kd-worker-9, which bypasses the scheduler, and the cluster has no such node (it has kd-faults-control-plane), so no kubelet runs the pod and the pod garbage collector deletes it; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.command: kubectl get pod web-78cccf7c5c-vpxf8 -n kd-nodename-missing -o jsonpath='{.spec.nodeName}'

findings.fix: Remove nodeName from the pod template and let the scheduler place the pod; to pin it to a node, use a nodeSelector on kubernetes.io/hostname with a node that exists.
